description: This file defines a database migration class 'FixBuyerId' which modifies the schema of the 'Orders' and 'Baskets' tables, changing the 'BuyerId' columns to have a maximum length of 256 characters and to be non-nullable.

classes.name: FixBuyerId
classes.description: A migration class that modifies the 'BuyerId' column in 'Orders' and 'Baskets' tables to enforce a maximum length of 256 characters and sets constraints on nullability.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the schema changes to apply the migration, altering 'BuyerId' columns to be non-nullable with a max length of 256.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Reverts the schema changes made by 'Up', restoring original column properties.
